films.title: Troy
films.description: Petersen's beach assault and Greek camp under fire borrow the Iliad's ship-fight stakes — Hector at the hulls as Hollywood spectacle.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Books XIII–XVI: Poseidon rouses the Achaeans, Hector breaks the wall, and fire touches the first ship — the crisis that forces Patroclus into arms.

popCulture.title: Ajax the Great
popCulture.description: Telamonian Ajax holding the ship against Hector remains the Iliad's image of stubborn defence at the waterline.

popCulture.title: Hector
popCulture.description: The Trojan who reaches the ships and calls for fire — the battle for the fleet is Hector's high-water mark before Patroclus turns the tide.
